A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 26-page HC-SMoE paper, including Appendices A-E. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish identical research content; only the first-page arXiv version/date stamp and its self-link differ.

before.justification: v3 reports original HC-SMoE evaluations on Qwen and Mixtral in Tables 2-3, plus appendix experiments on calibration choices, medical QA, compression, efficiency, and clustering.

after.justification: v4 reports the same original empirical results, including Qwen and Mixtral evaluations, DeepSeek-MoE results in Table 12, and MedMCQA results in Table 15.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain identical expert-output similarity, hierarchical clustering, frequency-weighted merging, and routing procedures. The exploratory method variants in Appendix B are also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same eight language benchmarks, MedMCQA, and C4/MATH/CodeQA calibration datasets. Appendix task and domain coverage is identical.

E2.justification: Tables 2-3 retain O-prune, F-prune, S-prune, and M-SMoE. Comparator membership also matches within every appendix comparison, including ZipIt and Fuzzy C-Means experiments.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and the appendix protocols are identical, including model reductions, 32 calibration sequences of 2,048 tokens, zero-shot evaluation, and the two-shot MedMCQA setup.

E4.justification: Section 4.3 and Appendices B-E retain the same linkage, similarity, merging, calibration, soft-clustering, extreme-reduction, efficiency, cluster-quality, and activation-frequency analyses.

E5.justification: Table 20 retains identical plus/minus uncertainty reporting for throughput and latency. No repeated-run, seed, confidence-interval, or statistical-testing information changes elsewhere.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings match across the main text and appendices. For example, Table 2 retains HC-SMoE average-linkage accuracies of 0.5716 and 0.5223 for Qwen with 45 and 30 experts per layer.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, Appendix A approximation-error derivation and stated clustering bound, and Appendix B soft-clustering equations are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about retraining-free, task-agnostic, scalable expert merging and its performance advantages.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and qualifications are unchanged, including soft-clustering routing interference in Appendix B.5 and the absence of router-latency benefits from retaining router weights in Appendix C.

D1.justification: Algorithm descriptions, calibration instructions, hardware and runtime information, the MedMCQA prompt template, and code/model access links are identical.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the bibliography are identical. No cited works or substantive positioning relative to prior pruning, merging, or clustering research change.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v3, 17 Jul 2025 to v4, 26 Oct 2025, with a corresponding self-link update. Prose, terminology, section organization, and appendix structure are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1-13 and Tables 1-23 retain identical displays, captions, and placement. Rendered pages 2-26 match exactly; the first-page difference is confined to the version/date stamp.

improvement.justification: v4 changes only the arXiv version/date stamp and self-link. Methods, empirical evidence, theory, interpretations, reproducibility information, and substantive presentation remain identical throughout the paper and appendices, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
